description: Native pixel dimensions are in the coordinate system of the vendor display shape when available. Panel rotation swaps the axes. The display_shape field contains the original Android framework SVG fill path. Some paths define the silhouette by cutting the corners out of a full rectangle. Top and bottom radii are the separate Android framework rounded-corner resource values.
shape_license: Display paths from pinned AOSP overlay sources carry the Apache-2.0 license. Pixel 10 and 11 geometry is also checked against the stock Google vendor framework resources in the linked OTA image. Only numeric display geometry is recorded.

pixel_10_pro_fold_cover.shape_note: The stock framework path spans 1080 x 2424, which differs from the published cover panel height. Use the published native dimensions with the stock rounded-corner radii.
